capture.notes: Three StableDiffusionPipeline calls (DDIM, Euler, DPM-Solver++ 2M), same prompt and seed; hooks only observe, and an unhooked DDIM call gives the identical image. Attention probabilities are rebuilt as softmax(q·kᵀ/√d) from the captured q and k and checked against the model's attention output. Level maps are the RMS over all channels of each block's output at each pixel. Previews are 128 px JPEG decodes by the pipeline's own VAE.
